name: Marietta College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college. Ranked among the top Best Midwestern Regional Colleges by U.S. News (tied ~17th in the 2025 edition). Acceptance rate ~79%; roughly 950-1,000 undergraduates. Known for programs including petroleum engineering, athletic training, education, and pre-professional tracks.
financial_aid: Roughly 86% of undergraduates receive some form of financial aid (2023-24, per Univstats). Merit and need-based institutional aid available; average aid reported around $29,000. As an NCAA Division III institution, Marietta does not award athletic scholarships. Verify current figures with the Marietta College financial aid office.
facilities_notes: Softball competes on campus in Marietta, OH. Athletics facilities information is available via the Marietta College athletics (Pioneers) site facilities page; specific softball field naming/details were not confirmed on the softball program page checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference (OAC). Head coach Jenn Castle is in her eighth season (2025-26) and was named 2026 BSN Sports OAC Female Administrator of the Year, reflecting an established program within the conference.
notes: Athletics site domain resolves at pioneers.marietta.edu (gomarietta.com was unreachable from the research environment). Coaching staff, roster size (20), and conference confirmed live from pioneers.marietta.edu on 2026-07. Tuition figure ($39,652) reflects the most recent published annual undergraduate tuition (2024-25, via CollegeTuitionCompare); confirm current-year figure with the college. As a D3 school there are no athletic scholarships (scholarship_count = null).
